answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 7 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the meadow reference is updated at each whisper checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the tundra audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism thus earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 167 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
